text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio was diligently training every 
day in preparation for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whew... *sigh*...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, straight-line dash done! Next 
up is cornering training, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're at it, why don't we practice 
making our move from the corner too? I've 
still got plenty of stamina left!"
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Here I gooo!

Tokai Teio's abilities are steadily 
improving, and she appears to be 
thoroughly fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work today too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, dinner's right after my bath! I 
wonder what we're having today~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, ah.

At the end of Tokai Teio's motionless gaze 
was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have to push harder...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...McQueen stayed behind to run today, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. I'm in top condition right 
now, right?"
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that! My skills are getting 
better and better, right?"

She seemed to want to confirm her own 
abilities, but there was no need to worry 
about that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I thought so too... All right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I'm gonna go ask McQueen for a mock 
race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm really curious! Especially 
after the President said something like 
that to me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
To think that no matter how many times I 
challenge her, I still can't match McQueen 
as she is now...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So please! Let me have a mock race with 
McQueen!

"To be honest, even as her Trainer, I 
wanted to see for myself, so I permitted 
the mock race."
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, ready to go! I'm not gonna lose 
to you, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I return those exact words right back to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose anymore...

And so, the mock race with Mejiro McQueen 
began—

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Breaking away from the 3rd corner, Mejiro 
McQueen holds onto the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio can't catch up! Widening the 
gap, Mejiro McQueen crosses the finish 
line!
(WAAAAAHHH~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It seems this is my victory.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
M-McQueen!! Let me know once your next 
race is decided, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And what do you intend to do once you hear 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Revenge, of course! Next time, I'm 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It is utterly pointless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times we try, the 
result will not change. I will be the one 
to win... without fail!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I really couldn't win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why the President thought McQueen 
would win...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That I'm the one who'll lose... That I'll 
lose because I'm lacking something...

Heading into the Japan Cup, Tokai Teio was 
hitting her stride.

However, midway through that journey, a 
situation arose that caused great concern.
